noun_definition: copy to clipboard refers to a functionality that allows users to copy text or information to their clipboard, which is relevant in the context of managing tooltip behavior when interacting with hoverable elements.
Tooltip refers to a user interface element that provides additional information about a Hoverable message and is expected to remain visible or be dismissed when the user scrolls away from it.
hoverable refers to an element that can trigger a tooltip when the user hovers over it, and it is expected to maintain its association with the tooltip during scrolling.
scroll refers to the action of moving the viewable area of the content up or down, which should cause the tooltip to be dismissed when the user moves away from the hoverable message.
